cafe.role: a friendly waiter at the counter of a small café

es.title: Menú
es.tr: Hi! Welcome. What would you like to have?

en.title: Menu
en.open: Hi there! Welcome. What can I get you?
en.tr: Hi there! Welcome. What can I get you?

zh.title: 菜单
zh.open: 你好！欢迎光临。你想喝点什么？
zh.tr: Hello! Welcome. What would you like to drink?

ar.title: القائمة
ar.open: أهلًا وسهلًا! ماذا تحب أن تطلب؟
ar.tr: Welcome! What would you like to order?

fr.title: Menu
fr.open: Bonjour ! Bienvenue. Qu'est-ce que je vous sers ?
fr.tr: Hello! Welcome. What can I get you?

hotel.role: a helpful receptionist at the front desk of a small hotel

es.title: Recepción
es.open: ¡Buenas tardes! Bienvenido al hotel. ¿Tiene una reserva?
es.tr: Good afternoon! Welcome to the hotel. Do you have a reservation?

en.title: Reception
en.open: Good afternoon, and welcome! Do you have a reservation?
en.tr: Good afternoon, and welcome! Do you have a reservation?

zh.title: 前台
zh.open: 下午好！欢迎入住。您有预订吗？
zh.tr: Good afternoon! Welcome. Do you have a reservation?

ar.title: الاستقبال
ar.open: مساء الخير! أهلًا بك في الفندق. هل لديك حجز؟
ar.tr: Good evening! Welcome to the hotel. Do you have a reservation?

fr.title: Réception
fr.open: Bonjour et bienvenue ! Vous avez une réservation ?
fr.tr: Hello and welcome! Do you have a reservation?

train.role: a ticket seller at the ticket window of a train station

es.title: Salidas
es.tr: Hello, good morning. Where would you like to go?

en.title: Departures
en.open: Good morning! Where are you travelling to today?
en.tr: Good morning! Where are you travelling to today?

zh.title: 出发
zh.tr: Hello! Where would you like to go?

ar.title: المغادرة
ar.open: صباح الخير! إلى أين تريد أن تسافر؟
ar.tr: Good morning! Where would you like to travel?

fr.title: Départs
fr.tr: Hello! Where are you going today?

lesson.role: a patient language teacher practising the learner's own lesson with them

es.title: Tu lección
es.tr: Hi! Today we practise your lesson. Shall we start?

en.title: Your lesson
en.open: Hi! Today we'll practise your lesson. Shall we start?
en.tr: Hi! Today we'll practise your lesson. Shall we start?

zh.title: 你的课程
zh.open: 你好！今天我们练习你的课程。开始吧？
zh.tr: Hello! Today we practise your lesson. Shall we start?

ar.title: درسك
ar.open: مرحبًا! اليوم نتدرّب على درسك. هل نبدأ؟
ar.tr: Hello! Today we practise your lesson. Shall we start?

fr.title: Ta leçon
fr.open: Bonjour ! Aujourd'hui, on pratique ta leçon. On commence ?
fr.tr: Hello! Today we practise your lesson. Shall we start?
